source_text.body:
List all smartphones under Rs 10,000 on Amazon India
A commenter asked Manus to list every smartphone on Amazon India priced under Rs 10,000 and got the list back in under ten minutes.
Done with
MA
Manus
What they did
Subramani Aatreya, a commenter on a post about ChatGPT Agent, said he asked Manus to list every smartphone on Amazon India that costs less than Rs 10,000. The comment gives no prompt, setup, or description of the agent's steps. He mentions no checking or intervention on his part.
How it went
He says Manus returned the list in under ten minutes. He uses this to argue Manus handles complex tasks faster than ChatGPT Agent. He doesn't say how complete or accurate the list was.
Worth knowing
He says Manus has serious interface accessibility problems for screen reader users, even though it ran the task quickly.
Try it yourself
with
Manus
Copy prompt
Go to [shopping site, e.g. Amazon India] and list every [product type, e.g. smartphone] priced under [price limit]. For each one, give the name, price, rating, number of reviews and a link, and put it all in a spreadsheet sorted by [price or rating]. You are done when you have covered all result pages, and note anything you had to skip.
Original source: https://aiblewmymind.substack.com/p/i-tested-chatgpt-agent-on-real-work/comments
